description: Permanently delete a Jira issue by key. Destructive write action taking an EXPLICIT target — the issue key is required and there is no bulk form. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the delete being applied; the confirmation is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Permanently delete exactly one Jira issue by its required key, including the ticket's comments and attachments. Dispatches asynchronously, returning a job_id immediately; the deletion confirmation arrives via job completion. This irreversible destructive write has a single-record target.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the deletion confirmation -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the deletion was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the issue is gone. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the deletion confirmation lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, be explicit that the named issue was permanently deleted and that this cannot be undone. State the exact key that was removed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently delete a Jira issue by key.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.not_found: no issue with that key exists (it may already be deleted). jira.permission_denied: the service account lacks delete permission for this project. jira.invalid_params: the key was missing or empty.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.not_found: confirm the key; the issue may already be gone. jira.permission_denied: deletion often needs an elevated project role — grant it or ask an admin. jira.invalid_params: supply the exact issue key.
